annotations.title: Get a loan officer by NMLS ID

description: Use this when you have a mortgage loan officer's individual NMLS ID and need their full profile. Returns LenDb's sourced record: name, title, current lender and branch, employment history, state licenses with license confidence, specialties (such as FHA, VA, bank statement or DSCR) with the evidence for each, languages spoken, stated experience, the earliest state license record, public links (such as their page on the lender's site), disciplinary_check ('not_checked' means LenDb has not yet checked regulator records), the date the record was last verified and a canonical_url. US only. Phone numbers and email addresses are not returned; the LenDb profile page shows them after a human check.

nmls_id.description: Individual NMLS ID, digits only, e.g. 452476.

name: get_loan_officer

sample.description: True when the data is fictional sample data.
